races.display_title: Navan Racecourse Nursery Handicap
races.verdict: HOWLIN WOLF continued a theme of race-by-race progression when opening his account on nursery debut at the Curragh recently and with better still to come, Jack Davison's charge earns the tentative nod to follow up. There are plenty of nursery debutants in opposition however, Supreme Lord and Prince of Peppard the pair put forward to chase him home before the benefit of market clues. HOWLIN WOLF (IRE) SUPREME LORD (IRE) PRINCE OF PEPPARD (IRE)

races.verdict: A fiendishly-competitive sprint in which one final chance is given to ALL THE GIRLS to prove she's as good on turf as on synthetics having run a cracker from 7 lb out of the weights when finishing runner-up at Dundalk recently. Cool Azul continues to go from strength to strength so he may well emerge as the biggest threat, with Jon Riggens and Gotta Catch'em All another couple worth considering. ALL THE GIRLS (IRE) COOL AZUL (IRE) JON RIGGENS (IRE)

races.verdict: ALTO SAX has been better than the result on his last 2 outings and continues to look fairly treated on the form of his near miss at Leopardstown last month. Good Man Jack shaped quite nicely at Galway on his handicap debut given he met a bit of trouble on the home turn and this unexposed sort is second choice ahead of Colin Keane's mount Kc Bear , whose overall consistency since handicapping provides hope that he can bounce back from a lesser effort last time. ALTO SAX (IRE) GOOD MAN JACK (IRE) KC BEAR (IRE)

races.verdict: Group 2 entrant NIGHT OF GOLD ticks plenty of boxes on paper representing the George Boughey/Billy Loughnane combination and he could be worth siding with to score at the first time of asking before market clues. races.verdict: The 3-y-os look to hold a strong hand here and rate the pair to focus on. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY got back on the up and displayed a good attitude in the process when defeating a next-time-out winner at Leicester 4 weeks ago and shades preference over Worlington who looks worthy of a try at this trip. Currumbin is another to keep an eye on returned to a longer distance from his reduced mark. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY WORLINGTON CURRUMBIN (IRE)
